mapper.select: select a.*,IF(b.ID is not null,b.NAME,c.NAME) as objName, IF(b.ID is not null,'1','2') as objType from PAN_FILE_RIGHT a left join SYS_USER b on a.OBJECT_ID = b.ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and b.USER_STATUS = 'ENABLE' left join SYS_ORG c on a.OBJECT_ID = c.ID and c.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.USER_FILE_ID = #{userFileId} and (b.ID is not null or c.ID is not null)
